name: TravelProof
tagline: Prove who the counterparty is. Keep who they are off the ledger.
description: FATF Travel Rule transmittal records with a DON-signed attestation on Base Sepolia. Verify the person, hide the person.

colors._note: Source of truth is oklch in app/globals.css; hex below are baked sRGB equivalents for standalone assets (SVG/PNG).

roles.serif: voice - headings, document body, determinations, § glyph
roles.sans: UI - nav, buttons, labels, helper text
roles.mono: data - ring text, gate labels, field keys, hashes, eyebrows

elevation.sunken: carved into surface (inset shadow, darker, recessed) - inputs, enclave, trays
elevation.flat: printed on surface (paper tone + hairline, no shadow)
elevation.raised: card on desk (e2: 2-layer shadow + lit top edge)
elevation.lifted: slip/sheet above cards (e3: long soft + contact shadow)
elevation.floating: verdict plate, nav, CTAs (e4: tall blur + ambient colour glow)
elevation.protruding: stamps, nodes, seals, ribbon tabs (e5: tight dark contact + highlight, overlaps parent edge)

logo.source: components/Seal.tsx (notarial guilloché rosette; 4 gate arcs CLASSIFY/ENCLAVE/SCREEN/ATTEST; § center glyph; void/crack state)

fonts.googleFonts: Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
fonts.pdf: serif + sans embedded; Courier for data (IBM Plex Mono crashes fontkit on hex)
